# yopl — Quick API Reference

<!-- TODO(step 5): fill in concrete API once typings/docs are written. -->

`yopl` is an ES6 mini-library implementing a Prolog-style logic solver. Unification is delegated
to `deep6`, yopl's only runtime dependency (a zero-dependency library).

## Entry points

- `yopl` (`src/solve.js`) — solver core / main entry
- `yopl/solvers/gen.js` — synchronous generator-based driver
- `yopl/solvers/async.js` — async callback-based driver
- `yopl/solvers/asyncGen.js` — async generator driver
- `yopl/rules/logic.js` — logical connectives
- `yopl/rules/comp.js` — comparison rules
- `yopl/rules/math.js` — arithmetic rules
- `yopl/rules/bits.js` — bitwise rules
- `yopl/rules/system.js` — system / utility rules

## Conventions

- ES6 modules; `"type": "module"`.
- Single runtime dependency: `deep6`.
- 2-space indent, single quotes, semicolons (Prettier).
